LESSON: KUSOMA 3.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA USHAIRI USHAIRI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: UTUNZAJI WA WANYAMA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Mapendekezo ya
Topic 3.2: Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya shairi ili kulitofautisha na tungo nyingine
2. kujadili sifa za ushairi kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi
3. kueleza sifa za ushairi katika shairi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya shairi ili kulitofautisha na tungo nyingine
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya shairi ili kulitofautisha na tungo nyingine. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili sifa za ushairi kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili sifa za ushairi kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kueleza sifa za ushairi katika shairi
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza sifa za ushairi katika shairi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya shairi ili kulitofautisha na tungo nyingine

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi ushairi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya shairi ili kulitofautisha na tungo nyingine
2. kujadili sifa za ushairi kama utanzu wa fasihi andishi
3. kueleza sifa za ushairi katika shairi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
